text: Raccoon River at Van Meter: 11.6 mg/L nitrate-N on Nov 13, 2026 (above the 10 mg/L drinking-water limit). Over the next 14 days the river is expected to stay about level: by Nov 27 the middle estimate is 11.2 mg/L, and 8 in 10 outcomes fall between 9.8 and 12.3. Expect about 12 of the next 14 days above 10 mg/L (chance on day 14: 74%). Soil moisture is much higher than usual for this time of year (root-zone wetness at the 100th percentile of 2016-2025), the last 7 days brought 0 mm of rain (lower than usual), and satellite bare cropland is at the 10th percentile (estimated: the latest usable MODIS image is 27 days old). No weather forecast is used: a big storm would push nitrate outside this range. In 2023-2025 tests this outlook beat 'no change' by 19% (1 week) and 24% (2 weeks) in squared error.
